Passenger side of the tub. 230 V (orange) on the wall side of the tray divider, its own drop, gland row and cabinet gland.

230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
VIEW OUTBOARD — from inside the tub toward the passenger wall · 1:6 on A3
PLAN — passenger strip (tray, channel, cabinet) · 1:6 on A3
CABLES IN THE TRAY, CHANNEL AND CABINET
U11 box (MC4 couplers at the v…
Tray (R07/R08): 120 mm aluminium over the drawer carcass; 230 V outboard of the divider, 12 V inboard; ties through the slots every 120 mm.
Wall channel (R09/R10): 22 mm behind the drawer runner panel; two layers of 12 V cables, 230 V in its own drop 135 mm further forward.
Gland plate (old 240 V outlet hole, 120 × 90): one grommet row for 230 V (R09), two rows for 12 V (R32); cut the plate from 3 mm aluminium.
Cabinet: 12 V through a 100 × 22 slot with a split grommet (R12), 230 V through its own 28 mm gland (R11) beside the RCBO enclosure.
